base_prompt:
A high-end stylised 3D animated feature film, cinematic and colourful, family comedy-adventure tone, expressive cartoon character animation with squash-and-stretch, detailed fur and fabric, soft global illumination, rich saturated colour, shallow depth of field, anamorphic widescreen framing, smooth professional camera work.
Setting: a cavernous chamber so comprehensively grey that even the shadows are grey, with a reinforced steel cage at its centre. Lighting: cold flat grey light, a single spotlight on the cage.
In the shot: Tomkin, an anthropomorphic tabby cat who walks upright, slim and wiry, with burnt-orange "artisanal copper" fur and darker copper tiger stripes, bright emerald-green eyes, long expressive whiskers, a smug confident half-smile, brass welding goggles pushed up on his forehead, and a leather tool belt full of tiny gadgets; Ben Elf, a tiny elf about the height of a teacup, neat and bright-eyed, wearing a pointed green hat, a green jacket with eleven unnecessary pockets, and a belt hung with a small brass horn, a spare horn, a scroll, a magnifying glass, a bag of mixed nuts and a laminated official ID card; the Grumpy Glitch-Bots, boxy grey rectangular robots shaped like small filing cabinets on stubby metal legs, each with a small speaker grille for a mouth, a single blinking red sensor eye, and a chest panel covered in rows of grey buttons; they move stiffly in rigid formation.
Camera: Medium on Tomkin and Ben, then wide on the retreating Bots.
Action: Tomkin throws up his paws; Ben scribbles furiously in his mission log and blows his horn.
Dialogue: Tomkin (crisp, rapid-fire, precise male tenor with a clipped British accent; superior, exasperated, always certain he is the only rational being in the room, exasperated) says: "It worked unpredictably, which is not the same thing as working!"
Sound effects: horn toot, robotic giggling, paper whooshing down a vent, ambience of low hum, squirrel chittering echoing.
Audio: dialogue and sound effects only, no background music, no narrator other than the characters speaking. No subtitles, no captions, no readable on-screen text.
extension_prompt:
Continue this exact shot seamlessly: same characters, same designs, same setting, same lighting and same 3D animated style (Tomkin, Ben Elf, The Grumpy Glitch-Bots).
Action: Giggling Glitch-Bots retreat into the depths, trying to sort gingerbread crumbs by size, while the last of their paperwork swirls down a ventilation shaft.
Dialogue: Ben Elf (high-pitched, chipper, officious little male voice, delighted by everything, speaking in excited exclamations, thrilled) says: "'Gingerbread house!' Four syllables! ELF CONFECTIONERY ALERT!"
Sound effects continue: horn toot, robotic giggling, paper whooshing down a vent.
Audio: dialogue and sound effects only, no background music, no narrator other than the characters speaking. No subtitles, no captions, no readable on-screen text.
negative_prompt: live action, photorealistic humans, 2D flat animation, anime, sketch, subtitles, captions, on-screen text, watermark, logo, distorted faces, extra limbs, extra fingers, flicker, background music
